prompts.rough: A low flat wrestling ring on packed earth: a square of uneven rough wooden stakes joined by two taut ropes, a plank laid across two barrels at one side. Beside it stands a single beautiful ancient stone arch of weathered grey-ochre masonry, buried in the soil up to its shoulders, far too fine for the scrap-wood ring. A small lantern hangs inside the arch. A strong woman in a plain tunic leans a hand on the arch and stretches her calf. Matte dull stone, no shine, no gilding, no weapons. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab.
prompts.grand: A horseshoe of ancient grey-ochre stone arcades, two storeys of large empty arches with the sky clearly visible through them, open at the front, the back wall higher than a person. Eight big arches rather than many small ones. Stone benches inside, five thin straight masts, iron torch stands, a podium of three steps, raked pale sand in the middle with the stake-and-rope ring still standing on it. A strong woman in a plain tunic throws a weighted sack on the sand, alone. The top edge of the stone is uneven. Matte dull stone, no shine, no gilding, no weapons, no closed circle, no dome. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab.
prompts.mythic: A crescent wave of ancient ochre-grey stone arcades, seen from above at three quarters. At the front right it is one storey low; it climbs toward the back left to four storeys of thin dark empty arches with the sky showing through, and ends abruptly in a tall broken jagged spur, like the broken end of a ruined amphitheatre. The crescent is wide open at the front: never a closed cylinder, never a dome, never a tower. Matte stone with faint matte amber veins, no shine, no gilding. In the open middle, raked sand with the small stake-and-rope ring, and on a three-step podium a hen wearing a small green wreath of matte leaves, with a strong woman one step below it, facing the hen. Empty benches, nobody else. Unevenly broken top edge. No weapons, no trophy, no cup. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab.

prompts.rough: A small wrestling ring of uneven wooden stakes joined by taut ropes on packed earth, a barrel in the middle used as an arm-wrestling table. At its edge a single crooked ramshackle shack of salvaged planks leans clearly toward the ring, propped by a barrel, with a shutter for a wall and a small amber-lit skylight turned toward the ring. A strong woman in a plain tunic arm-wrestles an old white-haired woman who knits with her other hand, both seated at the barrel, large and clear. Matte dull wood, no shine, no hanging cloth, no weapons. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab.
prompts.grand: A horseshoe-shaped enclosure of wood, a tall open timber stand with two superposed tiers of wooden galleries and balconies, all turned inward toward a round raked sand ring that fills the center and is clearly visible. The upper gallery juts much further forward than the lower one, so the outline is a funnel wider at the top than at the bottom; one continuous wooden structure, not separate houses, open at the front. Black oak beams, ochre plaster, rust-red tiles, lanterns under the beams. A strong woman wearing a plain linen tunic with a leather belt and long sleeves, no modern clothing, does pull-ups on a gallery beam, alone. Matte dull wood, no shine, no gilding, no weapons, no hanging cloth, no cast shadow painted on the ground, a small feathered patch of ground, no hard-edged diamond slab.
prompts.mythic: A horseshoe of at most six black-oak and slate timber houses around a raked sand ring, open at the front so the sand is always visible, wider at the top than at the bottom because every upper storey leans and juts over the ring. At the back stands one very narrow, very tall four-storey black-oak house, much taller than all the others, whose whole body is a visibly curved bent neck: its lower floors rise straight, then the upper three floors arc forward in a clear curve until its small gabled top hangs out over the middle of the ring, like a giant leaning forward to watch, with two small windows at the tip like eyes. The curve is obvious from the silhouette alone, not a straight tower. The other houses lean outward only slightly. The upper storeys of every house jut forward over the sand on heavy brackets, so the whole outline is a funnel much wider at the top than at the bottom. Rigid wooden shutters flung open, carved beams, slate roofs, matte dark wood, no shine, no gilding, no hanging cloth. In the middle of the sand, a large clear arm-wrestling scene: a strong woman and a small old white-haired woman at a barrel, the strong woman's free arm raised. No weapons, no trophy. Not a hamlet, not an inn. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab.
